summary: Build claims fraud detection skills with practical tools, analytics, and controls. Train your team to reduce leakage and improve investigations.
lede: Claims management training helps claims professionals assess claim validity and prioritize suspicious files. For adjusters, investigators, managers, auditors, and operations analysts, it covers reviewing evidence and data quality, recognizing fraud indicators, building risk-scoring and triage workflows, and documenting investigations. Participants also practice designing claims controls and preparing fraud trend and exception reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, investigate, review, audit, or govern claims files where fraud risk, leakage, and recovery decisions affect financial and operational outcomes.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites include working knowledge of claims processing, basic insurance operations, and familiarity with case files or exception handling. Exposure to fraud investigations, loss adjustment, compliance review, or operational risk is helpful, but no coding is required. You should be comfortable reading claims summaries, interpreting supporting documents, and working with spreadsheets or claims dashboards. Advanced concepts such as AI-assisted anomaly detection and automated claims triage are covered at an operational level, not as technical engineering.
